risk_if_not_implemented: Without Stable Versions, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may be unknown, untracked, lost, stolen or left unprotected because they are not inventoried. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities (R-EX-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Stable Versions (AST-37.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Software & Firmware Patching
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct software patching for all deployed Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), including firmware.
compensating_control_2.justification: Software & Firmware Patching (VPM-08) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Stable Versions (AST-37.1) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
